exposure: emergency Cesarean delivery with accompanying hemorrhag
outcome: Changes in systolic blood pressure (SBP), heart rate (HR), and shock index (SI)
cohort: 161 patients with primary postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) who underwent PAE
finding: Pelvic arterial embolization for primary PPH was found to be safe and effective, with a high success rate even in hemodynamically unstable patients, although clinical success was significantly higher in stable patients.
